summary: Iter 228d testing complete — Draft creation polish (name, schedule, total_rounds, round_time_overrides, window_elapsed_actions, defer-to-user, missed_pick_action) + soft-delete/restore lifecycle + sweeper task. Backend: 7/7 pytests pass in test_iter228d_drafts_polish.py. Frontend: Verified end-to-end via Playwright against the live commissioner league — Create Draft form (name + scheduled date + rounds=25) successfully POSTed to /api/drafts (custom name 'E2E Draft …' persisted, scheduled_time='2026-10-15T19:00:00.000Z', total_rounds=25, time_per_pick=3600 [1h default]). Scheduled Drafts row rendered the new draft with formatted date 'Oct 15, 2026' and a delete (X) button with data-testid='draft-delete-{id}'. Clicking delete fired DELETE /api/drafts/{id}, the row vanished, and a toast 'Draft archived (recoverable for 15 days)' appeared. Re-fetching with include_archived=true returned the row with status='archived'. All 5 window-elapsed-* checkboxes present, all required data-testids (draft-name-input, draft-scheduled-date-input, draft-scheduled-time-input, draft-rounds-input, create-draft-btn, window-elapsed-actions, window-elapsed-{auto_execute|pause_draft|extend_timer|require_admin|majority_vote}, defer-to-user-hint, draft-delete-{id}) found. Sweeper task `_archived_drafts_sweeper` registered at server.py:919 with `asyncio.create_task(...)` at line 937; no startup errors in backend logs.

ui_bugs.issue: Collapsed row renders ONLY {draft.scheduledDate} (e.g. 'Oct 15, 2026'). The Start Time string is rendered only in the expanded panel (line 827: '{scheduledDate} at {scheduledTime}'). The iter228d requirement says the row should show 'Scheduled Date' AND 'Start Time' separately. The regression ('—') is fixed for newly-created drafts that have a scheduled_time, but time is not visible until the user expands the row. Old/legacy completed drafts without a scheduled_time still show '—' (acceptable).

action_items: (Optional / LOW) Inline the Start Time next to Scheduled Date in the collapsed Scheduled-Drafts row (DraftTab.tsx line ~781). Today the time is hidden until expansion. Suggested: `{draft.scheduledDate}{draft.scheduledTime ? ` · ${draft.scheduledTime}` : ''}`.

(Optional / LOW) Add data-testid='missed-pick-action-select' on the 'If a Team Misses Their Pick' select trigger. The defer-to-user option and defer-to-user-hint render correctly when selected (verified via backend pytest), but the select itself has no testid for UI tests to drive the selection automatically.
critical_code_review_comments: draft_engine.CreateDraftRequest now correctly accepts the new optional fields (name, round_time_overrides, defer_user_options, window_elapsed_actions, total_rounds up to 100). Validator pattern is clean.

routes/drafts.py soft-archive lifecycle is correct: DELETE sets status=archived + archived_at, GET filters status != archived by default, POST /restore reverts to scheduled. Commissioner authorization is enforced (403 for non-commissioners). In-progress drafts are correctly rejected from archival.

server.py:919 `_archived_drafts_sweeper` runs hourly with try/except guard around the mongo delete_many call — good defensive coding. The 15-day TTL is computed from archived_at via datetime.now(UTC) - timedelta(days=15) which is timezone-aware (no naive-datetime bugs).

CommissionerSettings.tsx splitDateTime mapper (lines 307-345) is well-isolated and handles both `scheduled_time` (ISO) and legacy `scheduled_date` fields, plus the seconds→capitalized-label conversion for round_time_overrides. Good backward-compat.
DraftTab.tsx line 781 — see the LOW ui_bug above. The expanded view at line 827 correctly does `{scheduledDate} at {scheduledTime}` so the data is available; just not surfaced in the collapsed row.

Waivers.tsx useLeagueSocket → toast on 'waivers_processed' hook is sound but was NOT live-tested this iteration (would require triggering an actual waiver run; backend pytests cover the engine separately).

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (Create + Delete + restore lifecycle all verified; only the row-level Start Time visibility deviates)

context_for_next_testing_agent: The scheduled-time input on the Create Draft card is a custom clock-picker with `readonly` attribute — playwright `page.fill` fails on it. Either skip the field (it defaults to 19:00) or set value via page.evaluate dispatching a native input event. Login on this app is HttpOnly cookie-based; the working pattern is `await fetch('/api/auth/login', {credentials:'include', ...})` from `page.evaluate`, then mirror the access_token into localStorage for components that read it. Confirmation dialogs (`window.confirm` from handleDeleteDraft) must be handled with `page.on('dialog', d.accept())` before clicking the delete button. Backend pytest is run with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL+MONGO_URL+DB_NAME env vars (they are not auto-injected into the pytest subshell — pass them explicitly).
rca of the issue: No critical issue surfaced. The single LOW-priority frontend observation: DraftTab.tsx line 781 renders only `{draft.scheduledDate}` in the collapsed row, omitting Start Time. The expanded-panel render at line 827 correctly combines '{scheduledDate} at {scheduledTime}', so the data flows correctly from POST → GET → mapper (CommissionerSettings.tsx splitDateTime) → row props. Fix is a one-line template change in the row span. The original regression of '—' showing up has been resolved for any draft that has a valid scheduled_time.
